body: Founder confirmed intent to use their Gmail app password (same credential as the SMTP send path) for IMAP read access, specifically to fetch a language-spec email sent to emilyspringerton@gmail.com. Wrote a plain, on-demand script (stdlib imaplib/email, no dependencies) rather than a service, matching the founder's own stated scope for email access ('queryable source, not chunking through yet'). Honors the explicit no-auto-logging-email-content privacy boundary. Syntax-verified but not yet run against a real mailbox -- credential not set yet as of this commit.
title: Added on-demand Gmail IMAP read tool (scripts/gmail_imap_fetch.py)
